card.name: With or without food
card.fires_on: The word "with" or "without" right after a dosing instruction, just before "food" or "regard to food". It appears in the dosage and administration section of drug labels.

modes.label: without before food
modes.description: "without" directly follows the verb or dose and leads into "food" or "regard to food".
modes.example: Administration Instructions ( 2.3 ) : Take<< without>> regard to food. Swallow whole;

modes.label: with before or without food
modes.description: "with" follows the dose or "administer" and begins "with or without food" or "with food".
modes.example: Administer REZDIFFRA<< with>> or without food. Swallow REZ

card.plain: It fires on the word "with" or "without" when a label says whether to take the drug with food.
